Volcano.summary: A volcano is a place where hot rock and gas come out of the ground.

Active volcano.summary: An active volcano is one that has erupted in recent history and may erupt again.

East African Rift.summary: The East African Rift is a place where the African continent is slowly splitting apart.

Hawaii.summary: Hawaii is a group of volcanic islands in the Pacific Ocean.

Geology.summary: Geology is the study of the Earth's rocks and the processes that shape them.

Earth.summary: Earth is the third planet from the Sun and the only known home to life.

Magma.summary: Magma is hot melted rock found under the surface of a volcano.
